rv.q: Perhaps best of all, OR starts and ends with a realistic optimism about the balancing act we all have to play as humans.

The problem is that all of the frivolity and subterfuge that drove many of Behn’s plays, and is intended to enliven this one by way of homage, is tethered to Behn’s quest to finish her first play ( The Forc’d Marriage; or, The Jealous Bridegroom ).

cn.t: Critics praise Liz Duffy Adams' witty comedy about trailblazing playwright Aphra Behn, applauding its ironic take on the writing life and celebration of a criminally underrated 17th-century woman who deserves her theatrical moment.
